name: adversarial-friends
description: Cross-examine specs, plans, and reviews using other agent CLIs as adversarial reviewers for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Challenge specs, plans, and reviews with other agent CLIs.
interface.longDescription: Adversarial Friends dispatches a spec, plan, or another reviewer's findings to other agent CLIs (claude, codex, agy, opencode) as independent adversarial reviewers, then merges their critiques into one ranked findings report.
defaultPrompt: Poke holes in this design doc using other models.
Get a second opinion on this review's findings.
Challenge this plan before I commit to it.
